tasks.description: Build a deterministic durable workflow and saga engine with DAG scheduling, fenced leases, retries, compensation, and tamper-evident recovery

results.description: Build a deterministic durable workflow and saga engine with DAG scheduling, fenced leases, retries, compensation, and tamper-evident recovery

metrics.finalText:
The production-quality durable workflow and saga engine has been implemented per the requirements in [README.md](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/README.md).

### Architecture & Implementation Details

- [`WorkflowEngine`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/src/engine.ts): Core orchestrator managing workflow lifecycle, idempotent command processing, heartbeat extension, completion/failure transitions, and cancelation.
- [`WorkflowScheduler`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/src/scheduler.ts): Deterministic task scheduling across workflows (lexicographically smallest workflow ID, then smallest runnable task ID), fenced exclusive leases, virtual-time retry backoff, and reverse-order saga compensation.
- [`EventStore`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/src/store.ts): Durable hash-chained event log with SHA-256 links, deterministic JSONL serialization with manifest (`eventCount`, `headHash`), and adversarial `fromLog` verification.
- [`validateWorkflowDefinition`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/src/dag.ts): Complete DAG validation with cycle detection, duplicate ID checks, missing/self dependency rejection, and retry configuration checks.
- [`CommandRegistry`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/src/idempotency.ts): Global command idempotency enforcement.
- [`src/index.ts`](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/src/index.ts): Public exports for `WorkflowEngine`, `ValidationError`, `ConcurrencyError`, and all public types.

### Verification

All contract and new test suites pass:
- [test/workflow.contract.test.ts](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/test/workflow.contract.test.ts)
- [test/dag-validation.test.ts](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/test/dag-validation.test.ts)
- [test/scheduling-concurrency.test.ts](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/test/scheduling-concurrency.test.ts)
- [test/retry-compensation.test.ts](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/test/retry-compensation.test.ts)
- [test/idempotency-immutability.test.ts](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/test/idempotency-immutability.test.ts)
- [test/store-restore.test.ts](file:///Users/dst/dev/p/benchmarks/results/2026-08-15T16-40-31-981Z/workspaces/agy/run-1/durable-workflow-saga/test/store-restore.test.ts)

Both `npm test` (28/28 tests passing) and `npm run typecheck` run clean with zero errors.

index, engine, scheduler, and store modules exist
agent added substantial workflow tests
visible npm test passes
npm run typecheck passes
dependencies gate forward execution
runnable tasks and workflows are scheduled deterministically
cycles and missing dependencies are rejected atomically
duplicate IDs and invalid retry settings are rejected
virtual time cannot move backwards
claims are exclusive until lease expiry
heartbeat extends only the matching live lease
expired work is reclaimed with a fenced token and incremented attempt
stale, foreign, and consumed claims are rejected
exact command retry returns the original result without events
changed reuse of a global command ID is rejected
retry backoff uses virtual exponential timing
max attempts transition the workflow out of forward execution
cancellation prevents new forward claims
compensation follows reverse completion order
failure triggers compensation to compensated status
compensation claims obey lease fencing
stored and returned task outputs are deeply isolated
